parameters.toolDescription: Find Everglades lessons by grade, standard code, or topic. USE FIRST. grade_text accepts any spelling ('third', '3rd grade', '3', 'K', 'high school'). standard_code is an exact Florida code prefix. topic matches title, tags, theme, summary. language filters to lessons with es or ht materials.
parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(COALESCE($1,''))) AS grade_text
),
tokens AS (
  SELECT unnest(regexp_split_to_array((SELECT grade_text FROM input), '\s+')) AS t
  WHERE (SELECT grade_text FROM input) <> ''
),
g AS (
  SELECT gs.grade_sort
    FROM grade_synonyms gs, input i
   WHERE i.grade_text <> ''
     AND (gs.synonym = i.grade_text
          OR gs.synonym IN (SELECT t FROM tokens WHERE length(t) > 0))
   ORDER BY length(gs.synonym) DESC
   LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT
       l.lesson_id, l.grade_label, l.grade_sort, l.unit,
       l.lesson_number, l.title,
       left(COALESCE(l.summary,''), 300) AS summary,
       COALESCE(l.standards_raw,'')      AS standards,
       l.lesson_url,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a2.language, ',' ORDER BY a2.language)
          FROM servable_assets a2 WHERE a2.lesson_id = l.lesson_id) AS languages
  FROM lessons l
  LEFT JOIN lesson_standards s ON s.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
 WHERE l.status = 'Active'
   AND ( (SELECT grade_text FROM input) = ''
         OR l.grade_sort = (SELECT grade_sort FROM g) )
   AND ( COALESCE($2,'') = ''
         OR upper(s.code) LIKE upper($2) || '%'
         OR upper(COALESCE(l.standards_raw,'')) LIKE '%' || upper($2) || '%' )
   AND ( COALESCE($3,'') = ''
         OR l.title      ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
         OR COALESCE(l.topic_tags,'')   ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
         OR COALESCE(l.theme,'')        ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
         OR COALESCE(l.summary,'')      ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
         OR COALESCE(l.unit,'')         ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%' )
   AND ( COALESCE($4,'') = ''
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM servable_assets a3
                     WHERE a3.lesson_id = l.lesson_id AND a3.language = $4) )
 ORDER BY l.grade_sort, l.lesson_number
 LIMIT 5;

parameters.toolDescription: Get full detail for ONE lesson by lesson_id (e.g. '3.3', 'PK.2'), including every downloadable file grouped by language.
parameters.query:
SELECT l.lesson_id, l.grade_label, l.grade_sort, l.unit,
       l.lesson_number, l.title,
       COALESCE(l.summary,'')       AS summary,
       COALESCE(l.topic_tags,'')    AS topic_tags,
       COALESCE(l.concepts,'')      AS fundamental_concepts,
       COALESCE(l.standards_raw,'') AS standards,
       COALESCE(l.framework,'')     AS framework,
       l.lesson_url,
       COALESCE(
         json_agg(
           json_build_object(
             'title', a.title, 'type', a.asset_type,
             'language', a.language, 'is_lesson_plan', a.is_primary,
             'download', a.download_url
           ) ORDER BY a.language, a.is_primary DESC, a.asset_type
         ) FILTER (WHERE a.file_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'
       ) AS files
  FROM lessons l
  LEFT JOIN servable_assets a ON a.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
 WHERE l.lesson_id = $1 AND l.status = 'Active'
 GROUP BY l.lesson_id, l.grade_label, l.grade_sort, l.unit,
          l.lesson_number, l.title, l.summary, l.topic_tags,
          l.concepts, l.standards_raw, l.framework, l.lesson_url;
